paragraphs: 3 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Saturday for 3 clubs across 3 levels, with Steven Brooks producing the night's most notable performance.
Steven Brooks worked 2.1 innings, allowing 2 hits and 0 earned runs, with 0 walks and 3 strikeouts.
One of his strikeouts came in the seventh, on a 2-2 pitch to strike out Kevin Parada.
Portland Sea Dogs fell to Binghamton Rumble Ponies, 2-14.
Brooks Lee also appeared for Minnesota Twins. He went 1-for-4. He batted 7th and started at 3B. Minnesota Twins fell to Philadelphia Phillies, 1-9.
Ryan Tayman also appeared for St. Lucie Mets at Single-A. He went 0-for-4. He batted 5th and started at C. St. Lucie Mets fell to Jupiter Hammerheads, 1-3.
